name: Hamana
engine: DirectX 9 (Direct3D), Susie plug-ins, Ghostscript for PDF
summary: DirectX-accelerated Japanese image viewer with archive reading (zip/cbz, 7z, rar/cbr, cab, lzh), two-image mode, slideshow effects and strong key customisation. Can run as a screensaver. Unchanged since 2006, the download is still on the author's site.
where_it_wins: GPU display filters (tone curve, sharpen) and 3D rotation
where_schnellbild_wins: Modern formats and real video playback
Recursive and regex search, file management, undo

no_account_no_tracking.note: Freeware download, offline viewer; no account or online feature in the manual
